outline: 本課程主要在教導學生將服務觀念轉換成企業流程，並運用服務導向技術將服務資訊系統導入企業流程。學生可以透過科學方法，學習如何創造與評估所實施之服務觀念，以及如何整合服務流程與資訊科技。
schedule:
W1 Course introduction
W2 The role of services in an economy/The nature of services/Service strategy
W3 Supporting facility and process flows
W4 (National Day)
W5 Process improvement
W6 Managing capacity and demand
W7 Managing waiting lines
W8 Service supply relationships
W9 Midterm proposal (I)
W10 Midterm proposal (II)
W11 Globalization of services
W12 Manageing service projects
W13 Capacity planning and queuing models
W14 Forecasting demand for services
W15 Managing service inventory
W16 Technology in services
W17 Final project (I)
W18 Final project (II)
assessment:
Performance in class: 35%
Midterm proposal: 30%
Final project: 35%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

1.Fitzsimmons, J. A., & Fitzsimmons, M. J. (2011). Service management: operations, strategy, information technology (7th ed.). New York: McGraw-Hill.
2.Kirchmer, M. (2011). High performance through process excellence: from strategy to execution with business process management. New York: Springer.
